library(tidyverse)
library(dendextend)
library(here)
library(gplots)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(pheatmap)

# =========================================================================
# 1. Load Data & Prepare Dendrogram Object
# =========================================================================
load(here("Outputs", "photophys_preprocessed_data.RData"))
source(here("Scripts/00_visualization_prep.R"))

library(tidyverse)
library(dendextend)
library(here)

# =========================================================================
# 1. Run pheatmap quietly and capture its EXACT leaf order
# =========================================================================
# Ensure pheatmap is saved to an object 'ph'
ph <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_scaled,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = my_hclust, # Your pvclust / hclust object
  silent       = TRUE       # Suppresses plotting while extracting structure
)

# Extract the exact ordered vector of sample names as rendered by pheatmap
ordered_samples <- colnames(heatmap_matrix_scaled)[ph$tree_col$order]

# =========================================================================
# 2. Re-align Metadata Directly to the pheatmap Sequence
# =========================================================================
meta_aligned <- data.frame(SampleID_clean = ordered_samples) %>%
  left_join(meta_filteredK, by = "SampleID_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    Symbiont  = "Durusdinium trenchii",
    K_3_label = roman_map[as.character(K_3)]
  )

# Build metadata tracks using the strictly ordered metadata
color_host <- species_colors[as.character(meta_aligned$Species)]
color_sym  <- c("Durusdinium trenchii" = "#2E8B57")[as.character(meta_aligned$Symbiont)]
color_k3   <- ann_colors$K_3[as.character(meta_aligned$K_3_label)]

annotation_tracks <- cbind(
  "Host Species"     = color_host,
  "Symbiont Species" = color_sym,
  "Cluster (K=3)"    = color_k3
)

# =========================================================================
# 3. Rotate the Standalone Dendrogram to Match pheatmap 1:1
# =========================================================================
# Convert hclust object to dendrogram and rotate leaves using pheatmap order
d_obj <- as.dendrogram(ph$tree_col)

# Format leaf shapes and site node colors in the EXACT ordered sequence
leaf_sites  <- as.character(meta_aligned$Site)
leaf_colors <- site_colors[leaf_sites]
leaf_pch    <- site_shapes[leaf_sites]

d_obj <- d_obj %>%
  set("leaves_pch", leaf_pch) %>%
  set("leaves_col", leaf_colors) %>%
  set("leaves_cex", 1.2) %>%
  set("labels_cex", 0.4)

# =========================================================================
# 4. Plot Annotated Dendrogram
# =========================================================================
pdf(file = here("Plots", "Aligned_Sample_Dendrogram.pdf"), width = 12, height = 10)

layout(matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 1), widths = c(3.5, 1.2))

# Panel 1: Dendrogram + Color Tracks
par(mar = c(5, 2, 4, 8))
plot(
  d_obj, 
  horiz = TRUE, 
  main  = "Photophysiological Sample Clustering (Matched to Heatmap Order)",
  xlab  = "Height"
)

colored_bars(
  colors    = annotation_tracks, 
  dend      = d_obj, 
  rowLabels = colnames(annotation_tracks),
  horiz     = TRUE,
  y_shift   = -0.5,
  bar_width = 0.3
)

# Panel 2: Legends
par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
plot.new()

legend("topleft", legend = names(species_colors), fill = species_colors, title = "Host Species", bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
legend("left", legend = "Durusdinium trenchii", fill = "#2E8B57", title = "Symbiont Species", bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
legend("bottomleft", legend = names(ann_colors$K_3), fill = ann_colors$K_3, title = "Cluster (K=3)", bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
legend("center", legend = names(site_colors), col = site_colors, pch = site_shapes[names(site_colors)], title = "Site (Leaf Nodes)", bty = "n", pt.cex = 1.2, cex = 0.8)

dev.off()
